title: Ethereal Snake Embrace
description: A surreal scene shows three women with flowing white hair merged into one figure wearing an orange floral dress, cradling a small dragon in her hands. A glowing purple snake with yellow eyes coils around her body, set against a black background with a lavender field, a European town street, mountains, a castle, and a bat-like creature in the sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy artwork of three merged female figures with long flowing white hair wearing an orange dress with large flowers, gently holding a small black dragon in her hands while a large glowing purple snake with yellow eyes coils around her body, dramatic scene with a lavender field in the foreground, old European town street with buildings and lamps on the left, dark mountains and a castle in the distance under a purple night sky, bat flying overhead, high contrast black background with glowing magical effects and sparkles
